name: saif-shines/scalekit-code-doctor
summary: Generate, review, validate, or fix any code that uses Scalekit APIs or SDKs. Covers all four SDKs (Node, Python, Go, Java), raw REST API calls, and both product suites — SaaSKit (SSO, sessions, RBAC, SCIM) and AgentKit (connections, tool calling, MCP auth, framework integrations).
